content_sections.heading: Mathura Anganwadi Helper Vacancy 2026: Project-wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 544 Anganwadi Helper posts are vacant across 11 Bal Vikas Pariyojana (Child Development Project) areas in Mathura district, covering both rural and urban zones. Ward/Gram Sabha-wise vacancy details along with reservation status are displayed on the notice boards of the Collectorate, Rajiv Bhawan, Tehsil, and Development Block offices, and are also available on the official website.

content_sections.heading: Mathura Anganwadi Helper Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only women candidates are eligible to apply for these posts. The candidate must be a resident of the same Ward/Gram Sabha where the post is vacant; applications from candidates of other wards/gram sabhas will not be considered valid.

content_sections.heading: Mathura Anganwadi Non-Employee Qualification
content_sections.text: The minimum educational qualification for the Anganwadi Helper post is Intermediate (12th) or its equivalent. The merit list for all Anganwadi Helper posts will be prepared considering qualifications ranging from the minimum (Intermediate) up to the maximum (Postgraduate) level, as applicable.

content_sections.heading: Mathura Anganwadi No Age Limit
content_sections.text: As on the cut-off date of 01 July 2026, the candidate's age must be a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 35 years. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: Mathura Anganwadi Helper Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through a merit list prepared on the basis of educational qualification (minimum Intermediate to maximum Postgraduate). As per government order, priority will be given to candidates from the BPL category, widows, and destitute/abandoned women. No written examination or interview is mentioned in the provided notification. For widowed candidates, a certificate issued by a competent authority will be valid. For divorced and destitute/abandoned women, an order issued by a competent legal/court authority will be valid. Redetermination of the BPL income limit will follow Samaj Kalyan Anubhag-2 Government Order No. 22/2015/2123/26-2-2015 dated 14 September 2015.

content_sections.heading: Mathura Anganwadi Helper Required Documents
content_sections.text: Based on the provided notification, candidates are required to submit the following: Educational qualification certificates supporting the minimum eligibility (Intermediate or higher). Income certificate issued by a competent authority at the Tehsil level (must be online-verifiable). Residence certificate issued by a competent authority at the Tehsil level (must be online-verifiable). Category-specific certificate where applicable - widow certificate from a competent authority, or a court/legal order for divorced or destitute/abandoned women. Any other document requirements are not specified in the provided notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Mathura Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible women candidates can apply online for the Mathura Anganwadi Helper Recruitment 2026 by following these steps: Visit the official website: upanganwadibharti.in Locate and open the online application form for Mathura district Anganwadi Helper recruitment. Fill in the required personal, educational, ward/gram sabha residence, and category details accurately. Upload the income certificate, residence certificate, and other supporting documents as required. Review the filled application carefully, since any error or discrepancy in facts, academic records, or data can lead to rejection. Submit the application before the last date - 13 September 2026, midnight 12:00 AM. Mathura Anganwadi Helper Apply Online: only online applications through the official website will be accepted; offline applications will not be accepted or considered under any circumstances.
